## 2. Statutory GovTech Gateway: KRA Certificate Retrieval & Returns
- URL: https://akubrecah.com/retrieval-portal
- Guide: https://akubrecah.com/articles/kra-pin-retrieval-online-using-id-number-itax-login-guide (Complete guide to KRA PIN retrieval online using National ID number, KRA iTax portal login, KRA PIN forgot password recovery, and instant KRA PIN certificate download).
- Purpose: Provides automated, compliant retrieval of official Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) Taxpayer PIN certificates and instant filing of nil income tax returns.
- Security: End-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption, automatic deletion of temporary taxpayer credentials, zero persistent retention of sensitive identity tokens.
- Supported Formats: High-resolution PDF document delivery via instant browser download, WhatsApp dispatch, and encrypted email attachment.

## 7. KRA PIN Retrieval Online Using ID Number & iTax Login Knowledge Base
- Canonical Guide: https://akubrecah.com/articles/kra-pin-retrieval-online-using-id-number-itax-login-guide
- Portal Visual Reference: https://akubrecah.com/blog/kra-pin-retrieval-portal.png
- Retrieve KRA PIN Using ID Number: Kenyan National ID holders who forgot their 11-character KRA PIN or registered email can visit https://akubrecah.com/retrieval-portal, select National ID Number, solve the security arithmetic question, verify their masked profile details, and download their formatted KRA PIN Certificate PDF for KES 20 via Safaricom M-Pesa with zero server disk storage.
- KRA iTax Portal Login & KRA PIN Login: The official KRA portal is https://itax.kra.go.ke. Taxpayers enter their 11-character iTax - KRA PIN (starting with A for individuals or P for non-individuals, followed by 9 digits and 1 trailing check letter), click Continue, enter their iTax password, and solve the security stamp.
- KRA PIN Forgot Password Recovery: If you know your KRA PIN and email, click Forgot Password / Unlock Account on https://itax.kra.go.ke to receive a temporary reset password. If you forgot both your KRA PIN and registered email address, perform KRA PIN retrieval online using your National ID number at https://akubrecah.com/retrieval-portal first to obtain your exact PIN and tax station details for an email amendment request.
- KRA PIN Certificate Download: Available via https://itax.kra.go.ke (Registration -> Reprint PIN Certificate) when credentials are known, or instantly via https://akubrecah.com/retrieval-portal using only a National ID number (no password needed).
